name: cobuilder-priority
description: Read each stop of a live session with the priority-dev interpreter, mark each reading, and send the chosen steps

priority_dev_dir.title: priority-dev folder
priority_dev_dir.description: The priority-dev checkout. The priority-dev CLI runs here.

program.title: Program file
program.description: The saved program to read with, such as D1. A relative path starts at the priority-dev folder.

timeout_seconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.description: The limit for each of the two CLI commands, at most 600.

llm_api_key.title: LLM API key
llm_api_key.description: Optional. Without it, the CLI reads priority-dev/.env.
